title: Female Micro-Entrepreneurship and Child Development
title_zh: 女性微型创业与儿童发展
title_primary: 女性微型创业与儿童发展
title_secondary: Female Micro-Entrepreneurship and Child Development
authors: Andrew Foster, Moritz Poll, Hyun Soo Suh
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Ultra-poor graduation programs (UPG) reliably reduce extreme poverty among adult recipients, yet their intergenerational effects on children remain largely undocumented. We study a child-focused UPG in rural Malawi that augments the standard graduation bundle with early childhood development (ECD) training, targeting mothers with young children in a population that is both severely stunted and approximately 1 SD behind international benchmarks on cognitive and non-cognitive development. In an RCT of 1,872 households, we show that the intervention raises child development by 0.16 to 0.26 SD within one year but has no significant effects on anthropometrics. Behind the impacts is a broad shift in parental inputs and behaviors. The results demonstrate that a child-focused anti-poverty program can generate child development gains that have not been documented in comparable programs without a child focus.

title: Multinational restructuring, friendshoring, and home country activity
title_zh: 跨国重组、友岸外包与母国经济活动
title_primary: 跨国重组、友岸外包与母国经济活动
title_secondary: Multinational restructuring, friendshoring, and home country activity
authors: Bruno Merlevede, Bernhard Michel
official: 官方在线 2026-09-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Geopolitical tensions have reshaped international trade and investment flows in recent years. This column uses data on the worldwide affiliates of European multinationals over 2010-2020 to study how these firms are restructuring their foreign networks. Foreign network restructuring has transitioned from expansion to contraction over this period, with an increasing share of episodes involving nearshoring, friendshoring, or both. Crucially, network contractions are not associated with higher home-country activity, contrary to expectations. By contrast, network expansions are shown to boost parent activity and domestic networks.
abstract_zh: 近年来，地缘政治紧张局势重塑了国际贸易与投资流动。本文利用2010至2020年间欧洲跨国公司全球分支机构的数据，研究这些企业如何重构其海外网络。在此期间，海外网络重构已从扩张转向收缩，涉及近岸外包、友岸外包或两者兼有的案例占比日益增加。关键在于，与预期相反，网络收缩并未与母国活动的增加相关联。相比之下，网络扩张则被证明能促进母公司活动及国内网络的发展。

title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Competition for College Admissions
title_zh: 高校招生竞争对宏观经济的影响
title_primary: 高校招生竞争对宏观经济的影响
title_secondary: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Competition for College Admissions
authors: Shijun Gu, Lichen Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To study how college‐admissions competition shapes parental investment and child‐development policies, we develop a heterogeneous‐agent life‐cycle model in which parents invest in children's human capital to raise future labor productivity and compete for limited college seats. Because families ignore their spending's effects on others' admission chances, competition creates a rat race with overinvestment. Estimating the model with Chinese data, we find that this externality accounts for a substantial share of parental monetary investment. Policies that reduce competition raise current‐generation welfare but may diminish future human capital. Taxing private education spending while subsidizing public investment can balance this trade‐off and improve overall welfare.
abstract_zh: 为探究大学入学竞争如何影响父母投资与儿童发展政策，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，其中父母投资于子女人力资本以提升其未来劳动生产率，并争夺有限的大学名额。由于家庭忽视其支出对他人录取机会的影响，竞争引发了一场过度投资的“军备竞赛”。利用中国数据对模型进行估计，我们发现这一外部性在父母货币投资中占据了显著比例。旨在减少竞争的政策能提升当代福利，但可能削弱未来人力资本。对私人教育支出征税，同时补贴公共投资，可平衡这一权衡并增进整体福利。

title: Fear as a Campaign Tool: Evidence from the 2014 U.S. Ebola Scare
title_zh: 恐惧作为竞选工具：来自2014年美国埃博拉恐慌的证据
title_primary: 恐惧作为竞选工具：来自2014年美国埃博拉恐慌的证据
title_secondary: Fear as a Campaign Tool: Evidence from the 2014 U.S. Ebola Scare
authors: Filipe R. Campante, Emilio Depetris-Chauvin, Ruben Durante
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the supply of political communication highlighting perceived threats, using the 2014 Ebola scare as a natural experiment. Analyzing Twitter posts and congressional newsletters from US House and Senate candidates, we find Republicans increased Ebola-related communication, emphasizing negative sentiment and links to immigration. This response was strongest in safe Republican seats, consistent with base signaling. The supply side was active, not reactive: the Republican response did not vary with proximity to diagnosed cases despite concentrated voter anxiety, politician tweets predicted public Ebola activity but not vice-versa, and more intensive messaging correlated with better electoral outcomes, controlling for local conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们以2014年埃博拉恐慌作为自然实验，研究强调感知威胁的政治沟通供给。通过分析美国众议院和参议院候选人的推特帖子及国会通讯，我们发现共和党人增加了与埃博拉相关的沟通，强调负面情绪并将其与移民问题相联系。这一反应在共和党安全席位中最为强烈，与基础选民信号传递一致。供给方是主动而非被动的：共和党的反应并未因与确诊病例的距离而变化，尽管选民焦虑集中；政治人物的推文预测了公众埃博拉活动，但反之不然；且在控制地方条件后，更密集的信息传递与更好的选举结果相关。

title: Global waste trade: Comparative advantage, the pollution haven effect, and externality costs
title_zh: 全球废弃物贸易：比较优势、污染避难所效应与外部性成本
title_primary: 全球废弃物贸易：比较优势、污染避难所效应与外部性成本
title_secondary: Global waste trade: Comparative advantage, the pollution haven effect, and externality costs
authors: Prakrati Thakur
official: 官方在线 2026-08-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I quantify how comparative advantage and the pollution haven effect (PHE) shape international waste flows and infer the associated externality costs by constructing a Ricardian model with generation, trade, and use as a production input of waste. Combining waste flow, tariff, and environmental regulation data with a meteorological pollution dispersion instrument, I estimate that a 1% increase in trade costs reduces various waste flows by 7%–29.3%. Stricter environmental regulation in origin relative to the destination lowers trade costs for certain waste by 7%–77.7%. Per‐unit externality costs increase but gains from waste trade decrease with income, with PHE contributing substantially.
abstract_zh: 我量化了比较优势与污染避难所效应（PHE）如何塑造国际废物流动，并通过构建一个包含废物产生、贸易及作为生产投入使用的李嘉图模型，推断相关的外部性成本。结合废物流动、关税和环境法规数据，以及气象污染扩散工具，我估计贸易成本每增加1%，各类废物流动将减少7%至29.3%。相对于目的地，来源地更严格的环境法规会使某些废物的贸易成本降低7%至77.7%。单位外部性成本随收入增加而上升，但废物贸易的收益随收入增加而下降，其中PHE贡献显著。

title: Is Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) feasible? The impact of land use and market-based tools on carbon storage
title_zh: 发展权转移（TDR）可行吗？土地利用与市场化工具对碳储存的影响
title_primary: 发展权转移（TDR）可行吗？土地利用与市场化工具对碳储存的影响
title_secondary: Is Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) feasible? The impact of land use and market-based tools on carbon storage
authors: Han Wang, Qing Kang, Zhoupeng Chen, Fengqin Li, Xin Nie
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Market-based instruments and land-use management are key mechanisms for emission reduction, directly influencing regional carbon storage and constituting critical considerations for achieving the “dual-carbon” goals. Previous studies have primarily assessed the response of regional carbon storage to land-use management, while largely overlooking the role of market-based instruments. As an integration of market mechanisms and land-use management, whether Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) can effectively improve regional carbon storage remains unclear. Therefore, it is necessary to explore the impact of TDR on regional carbon storage. This study employs the PLUS model to simulate four land-use scenarios in Guangxi for 2030: Baseline Scenario (BS), Development Scenario (DS), Protection Scenario (PS), and TDR scenarios (TDR). On this basis, the InVEST model is used to quantify carbon storage under each scenario. Through scenario comparison, the impact of TDR on regional carbon storage is identified. The results indicate that TDR improves regional carbon storage by optimizing land-use structure and reallocating development rights across zones. With a total carbon storage of 3269,444.5 × 10⁴t, the TDR represents an optimal solution that balances regional development and ecological protection, aligning with China’s territorial spatial governance and green low-carbon development policies. Therefore, this study provides an effective pathway for promoting low-carbon land use.
abstract_zh: 市场型工具与土地利用管理是实现减排的关键机制，直接影响区域碳储量，构成实现“双碳”目标的重要考量。以往研究主要评估土地利用管理对区域碳储量的响应，而很大程度上忽视了市场型工具的作用。作为市场机制与土地利用管理的整合，发展权转移（TDR）能否有效提升区域碳储量尚不明确。因此，有必要探讨TDR对区域碳储量的影响。本研究采用PLUS模型模拟广西2030年四种土地利用情景：基准情景（BS）、发展情景（DS）、保护情景（PS）及发展权转移情景（TDR）。在此基础上，运用InVEST模型量化各情景下的碳储量。通过情景对比，识别TDR对区域碳储量的影响。结果表明，TDR通过优化土地利用结构和跨区域重新配置发展权，提升了区域碳储量。总碳储量为3269,444.5×10⁴吨，TDR代表了平衡区域发展与生态保护的最优解，契合中国国土空间治理及绿色低碳发展政策。因此，本研究为促进低碳土地利用提供了有效路径。

title: Wealth, cost, and misperception: Empirical estimation of three interaction channels in a financial–macroeconomic agent-based model
title_zh: 财富、成本与认知偏差：金融-宏观经济主体模型中三种交互渠道的实证估计
title_primary: 财富、成本与认知偏差：金融-宏观经济主体模型中三种交互渠道的实证估计
title_secondary: Wealth, cost, and misperception: Empirical estimation of three interaction channels in a financial–macroeconomic agent-based model
authors: Jiri Kukacka, Eric Zila
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Financial–macroeconomic agent-based models offer a promising avenue for understanding complex economic interactions, but their empirical estimation is challenging, particularly when the relevant data are observed at different frequencies. We address this gap by developing a mixed-frequency adaptation of the simulated method of moments that evaluates macroeconomic and financial moment conditions at their native quarterly and daily frequencies within a single objective function. Applying it to a stylized integrated agent-based model on U.S. data from 1954 to 2025, we quantify three key interaction channels between the financial and real sectors. The stock market influences the real economy through the wealth effect on consumption and the cost effect on firms’ financing. Conversely, the real economy influences the stock market through a price-misperception effect that shapes fundamental valuations. Our results provide the first model-based empirical evidence that all three channels are statistically significant, offering novel insights into macro-financial dynamics.
abstract_zh: 金融-宏观经济主体基模型为理解复杂的经济互动提供了有前景的途径，但其经验估计颇具挑战性，尤其是在相关数据以不同频率观测时。我们通过开发一种混合频率的模拟矩方法适配来填补这一空白，该方法在单一目标函数内，以各自的季度和日度频率评估宏观经济与金融矩条件。将其应用于一个风格化的整合主体基模型，基于1954年至2025年的美国数据，我们量化了金融部门与实体经济之间的三个关键互动渠道。股票市场通过财富效应影响消费及成本效应影响企业融资，进而影响实体经济。反之，实体经济通过价格误判效应塑造基本面估值，从而影响股票市场。我们的结果首次提供了基于模型的经验证据，表明这三个渠道均具有统计显著性，为宏观金融动态提供了新颖见解。

title: Beyond free riding or free racing: a framework for understanding subnational tax policy interdependence
title_zh: 超越搭便车或竞相逐底：理解次国家级税收政策相互依赖的框架
title_primary: 超越搭便车或竞相逐底：理解次国家级税收政策相互依赖的框架
title_secondary: Beyond free riding or free racing: a framework for understanding subnational tax policy interdependence
authors: Allyson L. Benton
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Subnational governments operating under the same federal fiscal arrangements often make markedly different tax policy choices. Research explains this variation through vertical relationships between subnational and national governments, horizontal relationships among subnational governments, or both, and along either economic or political logics. This study offers a unifying analytical framework integrating these dimensions and logics to help scholars locate their research within the wider literature, identify adjacent processes that may interact with or confound their focal mechanisms, and specify appropriate empirical strategies. I illustrate the framework’s value through analysis of Mexico’s state vehicle ownership tax (2008–2024). Situating the analysis within the framework yields three competing arguments about how horizontal economic and political logics interact. Spatio-temporal analysis shows that partisan competition, not geographic proximity, is the primary channel of horizontal tax policy interdependence. This partisan effect is conditional on neighbors’ tax activity, but in an unexpected way: it is strongest where neighboring states hold their taxes steady and weakest where they are cutting most heavily. The case demonstrates the framework’s usefulness in revealing new substantive findings and prompting new theoretical questions.
abstract_zh: 在相同联邦财政安排下运作的次国家级政府，往往制定出截然不同的税收政策选择。现有研究通过次国家级政府与中央政府间的纵向关系、次国家级政府间的横向关系，或两者兼而有之，并遵循经济或政治逻辑来解释这种差异。本研究提出一个整合这些维度与逻辑的统一分析框架，帮助学者在更广泛的文献中定位自身研究，识别可能与其核心机制相互作用或产生混淆的邻近过程，并制定适当的实证策略。通过分析墨西哥州级车辆所有权税（2008-2024年），本文展示了该框架的价值。将分析置于该框架内，可得出关于横向经济与政治逻辑如何相互作用的三个竞争性论点。时空分析表明，党派竞争（而非地理邻近性）是横向税收政策相互依存的主要渠道。这种党派效应取决于邻州的税收活动，但以出人意料的方式呈现：在邻州保持税率稳定的情况下效应最强，而在邻州大幅减税时效应最弱。该案例证明了该框架在揭示新实质性发现和引发新理论问题方面的实用性。

title: Labour rights violations, exports and income per capita
title_zh: 劳动权利侵犯、出口与人均收入
title_primary: 劳动权利侵犯、出口与人均收入
title_secondary: Labour rights violations, exports and income per capita
authors: Céline Carrere, Marcelo Olarreaga, Camille Reverdy
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how the impact of exports of goods and services on income per capita varies depending on the extent of labour rights violations in the export sector. In a sample of low- and middle-income countries, we find that specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations tends to reduce per capita income, due to lower productivity in those sectors. The negative impact of specialising in sectors with high labour rights violations is stronger in middle-income countries than in low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了商品与服务出口对人均收入的影响如何因出口部门劳动权益侵犯程度的不同而有所差异。基于中低收入国家样本，我们发现，专门从事劳动权益侵犯程度较高的部门往往会降低人均收入，其原因在于这些部门的生产率较低。相较于低收入国家，中等收入国家中专门从事高劳动权益侵犯部门所带来的负面效应更为显著。

title: The youth dividend: Political impacts of demographic transitions
title_zh: 青年红利：人口转变的政治影响
title_primary: 青年红利：人口转变的政治影响
title_secondary: The youth dividend: Political impacts of demographic transitions
authors: Rédha Chaba, Michael Dorsch, Victor Hiller, Paul Maarek
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper revisits the political economy of transitions to democracy. We extend a canonical rational choice model of democratization by introducing demographic structure, arguing that it shapes the material incentives for political mobilization. Younger cohorts benefit from democratic change over a longer horizon and face lower costs of participation, as they are less economically and socially integrated. As a result, increases in the youth share–such as during the demographic transition–can create a “window of opportunity” for democratization by strengthening the threat of political unrest faced by autocratic elites. We test this prediction using country-year panel data with detailed information on population age structure. Fixed-effects regressions reveal a robust positive relationship between the youth share and the likelihood of democratic improvement. This effect is strongest for the youngest cohorts, in particular individuals aged 15–19. To address concerns about endogeneity, we implement an instrumental variable strategy based on lagged fertility, including variation from neighboring countries. The IV estimates are consistent with the baseline results and are interpreted with appropriate caution. We also show that the effect of the youth share is amplified during economic downturns, highlighting a complementarity between demographic and macroeconomic forces.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了民主转型的政治经济学。我们通过引入人口结构，扩展了一个经典的民主化理性选择模型，认为人口结构塑造了政治动员的物质激励。较年轻的群体从民主变革中获益的时间跨度更长，且参与成本较低，因为他们经济和社会融入程度较低。因此，青年人口比例的增加——例如在人口转型期间——可能通过增强专制精英所面临的政治动荡威胁，为民主化创造“机会之窗”。我们利用包含详细人口年龄结构的国家-年度面板数据来检验这一预测。固定效应回归显示，青年人口比例与民主改善的可能性之间存在稳健的正相关关系。这一效应在最为年轻的群体中最为显著，尤其是15至19岁的个体。为解决内生性问题，我们实施了基于滞后生育率的工具变量策略，包括来自邻国的变异。工具变量估计结果与基线结果一致，并需谨慎解读。我们还表明，青年人口比例的影响在经济衰退期间被放大，凸显了人口与宏观经济力量之间的互补性。

title: Behavioral Biases are Temporally Stable
title_zh: 行为偏差具有时间稳定性
title_primary: 行为偏差具有时间稳定性
title_secondary: Behavioral Biases are Temporally Stable
authors: Stango, Victor, Zinman, Jonathan
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Social scientists often consider temporal stability when assessing a construct and its measures, but whether behavioral biases display such stability is relatively unknown. We estimate stability for 17 biases, using lab-style elicitations in online surveys repeated three years apart. Biases are stable in the aggregate and at least moderately stable within-person. Within-person stability estimates tend to meet or exceed those for standard quantitative measures of patience and risk aversion, despite various pieces of evidence suggesting that classical measurement error substantially attenuates them. We consider implications for micro and macro modeling with potentially behavioral agents, and for survey and elicitation design.
abstract_zh: 社会科学家在评估构念及其测量时通常考虑时间稳定性，但行为偏差是否表现出这种稳定性尚不明确。我们利用相隔三年重复进行的在线调查中的实验室式诱发方法，估算了17种偏差的稳定性。这些偏差在总体层面具有稳定性，且在个体内部至少达到中等程度的稳定性。尽管多项证据表明经典测量误差会显著削弱个体内稳定性估计值，但其仍趋向于达到或超过耐心与风险规避的标准量化测量指标。我们探讨了这些发现对潜在行为主体参与的微观与宏观建模，以及调查与诱发设计的启示意义。

title: Determinants of Healthcare Provider Networks: Risk Selection vs. Administrative Costs
title_zh: 医疗提供者网络的决定因素：风险选择 vs. 行政成本
title_primary: 医疗提供者网络的决定因素：风险选择 vs. 行政成本
title_secondary: Determinants of Healthcare Provider Networks: Risk Selection vs. Administrative Costs
authors: Serna, Natalia
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows that health insurers’ decisions to include providers in their networks are influenced by a previously underappreciated source of cost savings: network administrative costs. These costs counteract insurers’ incentives to offer narrow networks, which in standard models arise from risk selection and negotiated prices. Using a structural model of insurer competition over network breadth applied to Colombia, I find that insurers engage in risk selection by excluding providers in services used by unprofitable patients, but that heterogeneity in administrative costs leads some insurers to offer broader networks. Results inform the design of risk adjustment and network adequacy policies.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，健康保险公司将医疗服务提供者纳入其网络的决定受到一个此前未被充分认识的成本节约来源的影响：网络行政成本。这些成本抵消了保险公司提供窄网络的激励——在标准模型中，这种激励源于风险选择和协商价格。通过将保险公司在网络广度上的竞争结构模型应用于哥伦比亚，我发现保险公司通过排除不盈利患者所使用服务的提供者来进行风险选择，但行政成本的异质性导致部分保险公司提供更广泛的网络。研究结果为风险调整和网络充分性政策的设计提供了参考。

title: The Uneven Impact of Industrial Zones on Formal Job Creation in Vietnam

authors: Brian McCaig, Margaret S. McMillan, Marina Mavungu Ngoma, Anh T. Pham
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Industrial zones are a widely used industrial policy tool, yet their effects vary enormously. Matching the timing and location of zone establishment to firm-level data in Vietnam, we estimate that a new zone raises formal employment by 2,000 workers within seven years. This average masks extreme skewness: a handful of zones generate the gains while the rest produce almost none. Zones near major trade hubs account for most of the effect, driven by export-oriented foreign manufacturers. Accounting for spillovers, domestic firms face agglomeration shadows nearby but gain farther out, while foreign manufacturers operate as enclaves, generating few local linkages.
abstract_zh: 工业区是一种广泛使用的产业政策工具，但其效果差异巨大。通过将越南工业区设立的时间与地点与企业层面数据进行匹配，我们估算出新建工业区在七年内可使正规就业增加2000人。这一平均值掩盖了极端偏态分布：少数工业区贡献了全部增长，其余工业区几乎毫无成效。靠近主要贸易枢纽的工业区贡献了大部分效应，其驱动力来自出口导向型外资制造商。考虑溢出效应后，国内企业在邻近区域面临集聚阴影，但在更远距离处获益；而外资制造商以飞地模式运营，几乎未产生本地关联。

title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系的选择：来自退伍军人的证据
title_primary: 公共与私人医疗体系的选择：来自退伍军人的证据
title_secondary: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
authors: Marika Cabral, David C. Chan Jr, Seth Neller
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题。这些退伍军人有资格通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）以及由医疗保险资助的私营医疗机构获得医疗服务。我们分析了在不同VA使用率地区间迁移的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）和地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量及便利性）的相对重要性。估算结果表明，VA使用的地理差异中50%–60%可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还发现不同医疗类型之间存在显著异质性：地区因素对住院和急诊服务的影响大于对门诊和初级保健服务的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法强调的供给侧特征——与VA机构的距离及等待时间——仅能解释地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA使用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。

abstract: This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本期特刊探讨农业领域温室气体减排的经济学问题。所收录论文从三大视角研究农业减排：减排激励机制设计、减排实践与项目的经济效益，以及生产者、消费者及其他利益相关方的采纳行为与响应。这些研究覆盖多个国家、生产体系及政策背景，共同表明：将减排潜力转化为实际减排成效，关键取决于激励机制设计、核算方法，以及生产者、消费者、监管机构和供应链参与者的协同行动。

title: Location Effects or Sorting? Evidence from Firm Relocation
title_zh: 区位效应还是分类效应？来自企业搬迁的证据
title_primary: 区位效应还是分类效应？来自企业搬迁的证据
title_secondary: Location Effects or Sorting? Evidence from Firm Relocation
authors: Pauline Carry, Benny Kleinman, Elio Nimier-David
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.
abstract_zh: 企业在地区工资差异中扮演何种角色？本文利用企业迁移作为新的识别来源，将企业分类效应与区位处理效应（即给定工人和给定企业在特定地点获得的工资溢价，例如由地理、基础设施、便利设施等因素导致）分离开来。基于法国和美国的数据，我们首先记录了企业迁移的关键事实：每年有4%的企业迁移，它们在保留自身活动和结构的同时调整员工队伍和工资水平。结合法国企业和工人的流动性，我们估计了一个分解工人、企业和地点对工资变化影响的模型。空间工资差异主要由分类效应驱动：工人构成解释30%，企业构成解释17%，两者共同定位解释34%。残余的区位效应仅解释2-4%。企业分类效应还解释了大部分城市工资溢价以及大城市中更高的工资增长。

abstract: We examine the long-run economic consequences of population decline when automation and education respond endogenously to the demographic challenge. We show that, despite negative population growth, positive per capita output growth can be sustained. In equilibrium, output grows in line with physical and human capital accumulation, with household saving behavior playing a central role in sustaining growth. Moreover, the income share of raw labor declines, whereas the share of human capital remains constant.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了当自动化和教育内生地应对人口挑战时，人口下降的长期经济后果。研究表明，尽管人口负增长，人均产出仍能保持正增长。在均衡状态下，产出增长与物质资本和人力资本积累同步，家庭储蓄行为在维持增长中扮演核心角色。此外，原始劳动收入份额下降，而人力资本份额保持不变。

title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
title_zh: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据
title_primary: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据
title_secondary: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
authors: Jose Miguel Abito, Konstantinos Metaxoglou
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的生产函数估计方法，融合了代理变量法与动态面板数据法的优势。我们的框架在Blundell和Bond [8]的水平方程工具变量集中，引入了一个基于经济理论的Berkson型工具变量，遵循Olley和Pakes [28]、Levinsohn和Petrin [24]以及Ackerberg等人[4]的思路。这一改进允许不可观测的生产率同时包含时不变（“固定效应”）成分和遵循潜在非线性马尔可夫过程的时变成分。代理变量法虽能处理非线性马尔可夫动态但无法应对固定效应，动态面板数据法则能处理固定效应但仅适用于线性马尔可夫动态，而我们的方法同时放宽了这两项限制。该估计量可通过广义矩估计法简便实现。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当生产率持续性较低且固定效应异质性显著时，本方法优于经典代理变量法和动态面板数据法估计量。

title: Can Evidence-Based Information Shift Preferences Towards Trade Policy?
title_zh: 基于证据的信息能否改变人们对贸易政策的偏好？
title_primary: 基于证据的信息能否改变人们对贸易政策的偏好？

authors: Alfaro, Laura, Chen, Maggie, Chor, Davin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Amid public skepticism toward trade, we investigate whether evidence-based information - concise statements of research findings - can shape trade policy preferences. In survey experiments conducted on U.S. general population samples from 2018-2022, we consistently uncover a “backfire effect”: information highlighting the benefits of trade, such as job gains in productive sectors or lower prices for consumers, induces protectionist preferences. We interpret this effect as stemming from prior-biased belief updating, whereby the information activates pre-existing concerns about competition for jobs and trade relations with China. These associations are evoked particularly among limited-attention respondents, as well as politically-engaged Republicans.
abstract_zh: 在公众对贸易持怀疑态度的背景下，我们探究基于证据的信息——即研究发现的简明陈述——能否影响贸易政策偏好。通过对2018-2022年美国普通人群样本进行的调查实验，我们一致发现了一种“反噬效应”：强调贸易益处（如生产性部门的就业增长或消费者价格降低）的信息，反而引发了保护主义偏好。我们将这一效应解释为源于先验偏误信念更新，即信息激活了关于就业竞争及对华贸易关系的既有担忧。这种关联在注意力有限的受访者以及政治参与度高的共和党人中尤为显著。

abstract: 在构建中国经济学自主知识体系中传承中华优秀传统文化是当前经济学理论创新的重大课题。中国古代经济思想的知识体系与现代西方经济学不同，它的重要特征是：国家本位和国家治理以及经济社会改革。它具有回应时代和历史需求的国家观念，所讨论和阐发的思想都是“国之大者”。土地制度、赋税制度以及租佃制度是中国封建社会的基本经济制度，也是千年经济思想史讨论的重大主题；农商关系的争论，实质上反映了中国古代思想家对封建社会...

title: Mortality, morbidity, and occupational decline
title_zh: 死亡率、发病率与职业衰退
title_primary: 死亡率、发病率与职业衰退
title_secondary: Mortality, morbidity, and occupational decline
authors: Sofia Bougt‐Hernnäs
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Is long-term economic stress from occupational decline linked to poor health or death? Using Swedish administrative data matched with US occupational trends, I examine this in reduced form and using instrumental variables. Workers who in 1985 worked in occupations that subsequently declined unexpectedly were more likely to die early than similar workers in non-declining occupations, with effect sizes of 6–19 percent of mean mortality. Cardiovascular deaths rose among men, while women faced higher mortality from alcohol, drugs, and suicide. Hospitalization days rose, as did prescription drug use for mental health problems. Effects were strongest for the lowest-paid.
abstract_zh: 职业衰退带来的长期经济压力是否与健康状况不佳或死亡相关？利用瑞典行政数据匹配美国职业趋势，我通过简化形式及工具变量方法对此进行了考察。1985年从事后来意外衰退职业的工人，相较于非衰退职业中的类似工人，更可能早逝，效应规模为平均死亡率的6%至19%。男性心血管疾病死亡率上升，而女性则面临更高的酒精、药物及自杀相关死亡率。住院天数增加，精神健康问题的处方药使用也随之上升。这些影响在收入最低群体中最为显著。

title: Fast, Order-Invariant Bayesian Inference in VARs Using the Eigendecomposition of the Error Covariance Matrix
title_zh: 利用误差协方差矩阵特征分解实现VAR中快速、顺序不变的贝叶斯推断
title_primary: 利用误差协方差矩阵特征分解实现VAR中快速、顺序不变的贝叶斯推断
title_secondary: Fast, Order-Invariant Bayesian Inference in VARs Using the Eigendecomposition of the Error Covariance Matrix
authors: Wu Ping, Gary Koop
official: 官方在线 2026-02-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Bayesian inference in Vector Autoregressions (VARs) involves manipulating large matrices which appear in the posterior (or conditional posterior) of the VAR coefficients. For large VARs, the computational burden of these manipulations can render empirical work impractical. In response to this, many researchers transform their VARs so as to allow for Bayesian estimation to proceed one equation at a time. This leads to a massive reduction in the computational burden. This transformation involves taking the Cholesky decomposition for the error covariance matrix. However, this strategy implies that posterior inference depends on the order the variables enter the VAR. In this paper we develop an alternative transformation, based on the eigendecomposition, which does not lead to order dependence. Beginning with an inverse-Wishart prior on the error covariance matrix, we derive and discuss the properties of the prior it implies on the eigenmatrix and eigenvalues. We then show how an extension of the prior on the eigenmatrix can allow for greater flexibility while maintaining many of the benefits of conjugacy. We leverage this flexibility to extend the prior on the eigenvalues to allow for stochastic volatility. The properties of the eigendecomposition approach are investigated in a macroeconomic forecasting exercise involving VARs with 20 variables.
abstract_zh: 向量自回归（VARs）中的贝叶斯推断涉及对出现在VAR系数后验（或条件后验）中的大型矩阵进行操作。对于大规模VAR，这些操作的计算负担可能使实证工作变得不切实际。为此，许多研究者对其VAR进行变换，以便贝叶斯估计能够逐方程进行。这大幅降低了计算负担。该变换涉及对误差协方差矩阵进行Cholesky分解。然而，这一策略意味着后验推断依赖于变量进入VAR的顺序。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于特征分解的替代变换，该变换不会导致顺序依赖性。从误差协方差矩阵的逆Wishart先验出发，我们推导并讨论了该先验对特征矩阵和特征值所隐含的性质。随后，我们展示了如何扩展特征矩阵上的先验，以在保持共轭性诸多优点的同时，提供更大的灵活性。我们利用这种灵活性来扩展特征值上的先验，以允许随机波动性。特征分解方法的性质在一个涉及20个变量的VAR宏观经济预测练习中进行了研究。

title: Research Direction and Science Evaluation: The Role of Coherence and Alignment
title_zh: 研究方向与科学评价：一致性与对齐的作用
title_primary: 研究方向与科学评价：一致性与对齐的作用
title_secondary: Research Direction and Science Evaluation: The Role of Coherence and Alignment
authors: Charles Ayoubi, Sandra Barbosu, Michele Pezzoni, Fabiana Visentin
official: 官方在线 2025-10-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The decisions of funding agencies greatly influence the direction of scientific research; however, our understanding of how applicants' research directions affect the selection process remains limited. In this study, we investigate how a project's coherence with a scientist's previous work and its alignment with current scientific trends affect the probability of winning a renowned research fellowship. Employing a neural network algorithm to compute these indicators, we analyze the text of 2494 research projects proposed by scholars competing for the Sloan Research Fellowship, one of the most prestigious fellowships for early‐career researchers in North America. Our findings reveal notable differences across fields in the effect of coherence and alignment on the probability of being awarded, reflecting distinct organizational norms. For instance, applicants with coherent and aligned projects have higher chances of winning in life sciences & chemistry. In contrast, in physics, bibliometric measures such as the number of publications and citations outweigh research direction characteristics in the selection process. This study aims to offer valuable insights into the factors influencing scientific selection processes, exhibiting how they shape the research landscape for early‐career scientists across various academic fields.
abstract_zh: 资助机构的决策极大地影响着科学研究的方向；然而，我们对于申请者的研究方向如何影响选拔过程的理解仍然有限。在本研究中，我们探讨了一个项目与科学家先前工作的一致性及其与当前科学趋势的契合度，如何影响获得著名研究奖学金的可能性。通过运用神经网络算法计算这些指标，我们分析了2494个由学者为竞争斯隆研究奖学金而提出的研究项目文本，该奖学金是北美早期职业研究者中最负盛名的奖学金之一。我们的发现揭示了不同领域中一致性和契合度对获奖概率影响的显著差异，反映了各自独特的组织规范。例如，在生命科学与化学领域，拥有连贯且契合项目的申请者获奖机会更高。相反，在物理学领域，诸如发表物数量和引用次数等文献计量指标在选拔过程中超过了研究方向特征的重要性。本研究旨在为影响科学选拔过程的因素提供有价值的见解，展示它们如何塑造不同学术领域中早期职业科学家的研究格局。
